title: Sinop Energia
description:
Overview

Country: Brazil | Website: sinopenergia.com.br | Revenue: $12.2 Million | Industry: Electricity, Oil & Gas | Employees: 51-200 | Properties:300 GB (43,113 Files, 5,372 Folders)
Detailed Analysis

Sinop Energia, through its subsidiary Companhia Energética Sinop, is responsible for the construction and operation of the Sinop Hydroelectric Plant in northern Mato Grosso. The company focuses on generating, operating, and marketing the energy produced by the plant for a duration of 35 years. It aims to support local communities through socio-environmental programs and investments, benefiting over 150,000 people. The company is jointly owned by EDF Norte Fluminense, Eletronorte, and Chesf
